comment: The rules `pubkit board` grades repositories by (rules.py says how each is applied). Each row gets three grades, A to E. Quality starts at SonarQube Cloud's worse rating of reliability and maintainability, Security at its security rating; with no analysis, each starts at A and takes the sonar notch. Then each tool below with findings takes one letter off its category's grade: a CI job on main's last run that failed, or open alerts, or a Scorecard score under `below`. Delivery starts at A and takes one letter for each notch in `delivery` that applies (to all, packages or services) and finds a gap. A grade never goes below E, but every notch is listed. The overall grade is the worst of the three. Drop an entry to drop its notch; `pubkit board --rules FILE` reads another file. `workflows` and `repositories` tell the board where to look: which workflow files are CI, nightly and deploy, and which repositories release pubkit and pubrel.
name: pubkit 2026-10

tools.covers: rustfmt, clippy, ruff, eslint, doc coverage
cargo deny, cargo vet, pip-audit, npm audit
